text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, a few days before Christmas. 
After finishing our usual training 
routine...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Though it was a bit late, I had prepared a 
present for Curren Chan after her 
magnificent first-place victory in the 
Sprinters Stakes. It was――

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"Visée Noire Christmas Exclusive Dinner 
Ticket"...?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Whoa~! That restaurant is super famous, 
right?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"It's always trending on Umastagram around 
Christmas time, after all."

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
A ticket with a massive premium attached 
to it! How in the world did you get your 
hands on this?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After thoroughly researching Umastagram 
trends, and ultimately relying on 
Chairwoman Akikawa's connections, these 
were the tickets I managed to get...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
...You thought so much about this for me. 
Thank you, big brother♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
...You thought so much about this for me. 
Thank you, big sister♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Curren Chan seemed happy with it too. 
Since there were several tickets, I 
suggested she invite her roommate Admire 
Vega or other friends—
choice_data_list: Go have fun with your friends!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: With a friend...?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: ...Not with Onii-chan?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: ...Not with big sis?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: No way! Curren isn't going.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Uncharacteristically, Curren Chan gave a 
flat-out 'no'..."

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: You're cheating, Big Brother.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Big Sister, you're cheating.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for working hard, thinking 
things through, and acting for Curren's 
sake. Of course I'm happy about that, you 
know?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Still... that's not what makes Curren 
happiest.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
You know full well, and yet you're 
deliberately looking away, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: You're an adult after all, big bro.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: You're an adult after all, big sis.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"...That's why I won't take the ticket. 
For now, that is, okay?"

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
It looks like there's still time, so I 
want you to wait until Curren grows up a 
little more.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Instead—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —And then, Christmas Day arrived.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Big Brother, over here, over here!♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Big Sister, over here, over here~♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Look over there, they're selling 
limited-edition Christmas cakes!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Curren wants to eat it~♪
choice_data_list: Shall we stop by and see?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Yup♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Per Curren Chan's request, we were walking 
through the streets lit up by 
illuminations. However...
choice_data_list: Are you sure that's all you need?
Is that really all you need?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"What do you mean 'just this'...? We're on 
a Christmas date, you know? I'd say that's 
a pretty big deal."

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
...Well, for now, maybe it's fine if Big 
Brother doesn't realize it yet.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
...Well, for now, maybe it's fine if Big 
Sister doesn't realize it yet.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Curren intends to stay a kid for a little 
while longer, too.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: L-i-k-e I said~...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Don't treat me like an adult just yet, 
pamper me loooots, okay?♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Pampered thoroughly by Curren Chan, 
Christmas night gently slipped away...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... What a great view! It looks pretty 
beautiful, don't you think?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After finishing normal training, at Curren 
Chan's request, we took a stroll up to a 
hill overlooking the night view.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
...Looking at the night view really makes 
you think about all sorts of things, 
doesn't it?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Inside every single one of those lights, 
there's someone...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
—Still, among them, there are still people 
who don't know Curren yet.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Until all the lights across the world are 
illuminated with cuteness, Curren can't 
stop moving forward.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I'm not quite sure what she means by 
“lighting up with cuteness”... but even on 
Christmas, her stoic dedication remains 
unchanged.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Besides... if Curren is being stubborn 
with her Onii-chan, she still has a long 
way to go.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Besides... if Curren is being stubborn 
with her Onee-chan, she still has a long 
way to go.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"About the Christmas ticket... I'm really 
sorry, okay?"

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
It made Curren really happy that you 
thought about her so much.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Still... that's totally unfair.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: ...You're not mad?
choice_data_list:
It's a privilege that she's willing to be 
stubborn with you.

It's a privilege that she's willing to be 
stubborn with you, right?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
...Aah. Curren's still not experienced 
enough after all, huh.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
You made Curren's heart skip a beat, Big 
Brother.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
You really made my heart skip a beat 
there, big sis / big brother.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Eheh...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
I have to master cuteness even more and 
become an extraordinarily wonderful 
Curren, you know?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, this is really fine for this year. I 
love spending time chatting with you, big 
brother. But, you know...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, this is really fine for this year. I 
love spending time chatting with you, big 
sister. But, you know...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
You already know Curren is a girl who gets 
everything she wants, right? Next year...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
I'll make you say you want to be together 
for Christmas too, just watch.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: ...Heh.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Ehe, look forward to it, okay? Onii-chan♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Ehe, look forward to it, okay? Onee-chan♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
For a while after, we gazed up at the 
stars and chatted endlessly with Curren 
Chan...
